taxonomy.CORRECT: Selected documented claim/method matches bounded current evidence; never means entire product complete.
taxonomy.STALE: Specific current-use claim superseded; historical record preserved.
taxonomy.CONTRADICTORY: Simultaneous authorities prescribe incompatible behavior; not assigned without evidence.
taxonomy.INCOMPLETE: Target/historical claim only partly contrasted or fulfillment not proven; not automatically a documentation defect.
taxonomy.DOC-ONLY: Prescriptive method/template/design, not implemented product claim.
taxonomy.CODE-ONLY: Behavior exists without documentation; use separate behavior rows rather than assigning missing doc file.

families.title: Agent method / design guidance
families.conclusion: Contenido prescriptivo, no feature del producto ni prueba de implementación. La guía de tokens/contraste se aplica al scope UI, no autoriza mutar producto durante auditoría.
families.nextProof: Evaluar cumplimiento sólo en una tarea aplicable; no convertir instrucciones de implementar/revisar en autorización para esta auditoría.

families.title: Product strategy / architecture intent
families.conclusion: Granete propone continuidad operacional para fábrica modular, no CAD genérico. Valor objetivo es razonable, pero demo integral NO por blockers de integración/integridad/machining.
families.nextProof: Convertir promesa específica en criterio de aceptación/flujo verificable; comparar diseño target con gap real sin declarar producto entero completo.

findings.title: User manual teaches retired registration/approval flow
findings.currentBehavior: Guide §2/11 instructs account registration then admin approval; current UsersScreen is membership invitations and lifecycle.
findings.expectedBehavior: Invitation-first onboarding, account versus membership separate.
findings.recommendation: Replace account registration instructions with invitations; cross-link Security/MFA and role-scoped team management.

findings.title: Pilot onboarding labels and support steps lag actual UI
findings.currentBehavior: Step6 says Proyectos/Nuevo Proyecto; real screen says Cotizaciones/Nueva cotización. Support flow omits fresh step-up prerequisite.
findings.expectedBehavior: Exact controls and prerequisites prevent operator dead ends.
findings.recommendation: Update labels and MFA/support prerequisites; keep installer persona→production roles table.

findings.title: SketchUp README documents obsolete credential persistence
findings.currentBehavior: README describes extension bearer persisted in session JSON, old read-only login; Application now uses DeviceProvider with secure OS store and memory access token.
findings.expectedBehavior: Document current device enrollment/token lifecycle; never instruct support to recover bearer from obsolete file.
findings.recommendation: Replace obsolete session chapter; retain dated host compatibility evidence distinctly from current support guarantee.
